title: Real representation of the inner product function
statement: For every natural number $n$, the real-valued function obtained by viewing the sign-valued inner product Boolean function on the sign cube of dimension $2n$ as real-valued equals the function obtained by transporting the real-valued, sign-encoded inner product modulo two from the binary cube to the sign cube.
